analyst.summary: [DATA/INFERENCE] Linde India is a high-quality, monopoly-like industrial-gas utility riding the steel/healthcare/electronics oxygen capex cycle, but it trades at ~111x P/E / 14.3x P/B after a Q4 FY26 profit miss (-59.9% QoQ), while an unresolved SEBI-to-Supreme-Court related-party-transaction dispute over project transfers with sister company PIPL keeps a governance cloud over the stock. No quant score exists yet, so the call defaults to Hold, but the valuation-versus-growth gap plus the live litigation are flagged for escalation.
